note: `generated: true` = a dedicated overlay under templates/sdk/kinds/. Any other SDK (listed here or new in a plan) is built from the generic overlay. `ports` = what a provider adapter implements, by channel (`*` = any); an SDK without `ports` uses `generic_port`.

sdks.title: One-time codes
sdks.description: Sign-in and confirmation codes sent to a phone or an e-mail address.

*.call: adapter.send({ to: '+10000000000', code: '123456', language: 'en', purpose: 'LOGIN', ttlSec: 300 })

sdks.title: Notifications
sdks.description: Push notifications and e-mail sent to users.

sdks.title: Payments
sdks.description: Charging, refunding and reconciling money through a payment gateway or mobile money.

sdks.title: File storage
sdks.description: Uploads of photos and documents, with signed links and a CDN.

sdks.title: Analytics
sdks.description: Usage events and reports about what people do in the system.

sdks.title: Maps and places
sdks.description: Addresses, distances, delivery zones and live location.
